title: Career Development and Succession Planning
overview: With 60% of organizations lacking a formal process for succession planning, this interactive course provides participants with cutting-edge methodologies and strategies for career development and succession planning. It offers practical tips on creating clear career paths and building organizational depth. The course also helps participants design succession strategies that foster business flexibility and sustainability.
audience: This course is designed for HR managers, line managers, HR business partners, team leaders, and specialists who want to enhance their skills in career development and succession planning.
methodology: A combination of interactive techniques, including lectures, case studies, and group activities, will be used. The course incorporates best practices in career development and succession planning, with participants encouraged to share their own organizational experiences for enhanced learning.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the fundamentals of career development and succession planning
Differentiate between succession planning, replacement planning, talent management, and human capital management
Shift from a traditional HR approach to one that emphasizes career planning
Clarify the roles of both employee and employer in career development
Implement innovative corporate career development initiatives
Design and manage an effective succession planning program to close developmental gaps
Create individual development plans and guide career progression
